Pay: R$20,000.00 – R$22,000.00 per month


Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer contractor to join our U.S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps . You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews , expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. Your role will evolve based on your strengths and our needs — all while adhering to rigorous coding and security standards .


Key Responsibilities

1. Product Design & Development

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancing existing codebases (opportunities starting around months 3–4).

2. Testing & Quality

  • Design and implement automated End-to-End (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability — with a strong focus during your first 6–9 months.

3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support

  • Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
  • Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.

4. Agile Collaboration

  • Actively contribute to 2-week sprints and 6-week release cycles (3 sprints per release).
  • Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.


Qualifications

Experience

  • 8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

title: Shopify Web Developer (CRO & Growth Focused)
description:
If you’re interested, please complete your application here: Only applications submitted through this form will be considered.


At Carbinox, we build rugged smartwatches for hardworking men in construction, welding, mechanics, and beyond. With over 400,000 loyal customers, we have earned trust by delivering durability, performance, and value. Our Shopify store is the core of our business, and we are looking for a Shopify Web Developer who can help us turn traffic into revenue through high-converting ecommerce experiences.


Position We Are Hiring For

We are hiring a full time Shopify Web Developer focused on conversion rate optimization, landing pages, and ecommerce growth.

This is an in house role, not freelance or contract. You will own the Shopify experience and play a key role in our revenue growth.


Job Expectations

You will be responsible for building, optimizing, and scaling the pages that drive our sales.

This includes:

  • Creating high converting landing pages for:

Paid ads

Product launches

Promotions and campaigns

Email and SMS traffic

  • Optimizing:

Product pages

Collection pages

Shopify sections and templates

Mobile experience

  • Implementing CRO strategies to improve:

Conversion rate

Average order value

Customer trust and clarity

  • Improving:

Page speed

Site performance

Funnel flow

  • Building Shopify sections so the marketing team can easily:

Launch campaigns

Test offers

Create new pages

  • Working closely with:

Media buyers

Designers

Marketing team

Your work will directly impact revenue and growth.


Basic Requirements

  • Full time availability
  • Advanced English, written and spoken
  • Strong experience with Shopify
  • Experience with:

Themes

Sections

Liquid

Shopify apps

Custom page building

  • Solid understanding of:

Ecommerce funnels

CRO

User behavior

Mobile optimization

  • Experience with DTC or ecommerce brands is a plus


Our Core Behaviors

At Carbinox, culture matters as much as performance. We work based on these five Core Behaviors:

  • Create progress, do not wait for it
  • Take ownership of absolutely everything
  • Be reachable and keep work moving
  • Honor the balance and turn it into impact
  • Do what you say, when you say you will

We are looking for someone who lives these values every day.


What We Offer

100% remote work

Full time, long term position

A fast growing ecommerce brand with real scale

A performance driven environment where your work directly impacts revenue

A culture built on ownership, trust, and execution

The opportunity to build and own one of the most important systems in the company, our Shopify store

title: .NET Backend Developer Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Verity está buscando novos talentos!


Somos uma consultoria de transformação e inovação digital e buscamos .NET Backend Developer Sênior para fazer parte dessa jornada.


Olha só quais são as experiências e conhecimentos que você precisa ter para acelerar e transformar com a gente:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

❖ Arquitetura:

➢ Entender os padrões arquiteturais propostos (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).

➢ Entender estratégias para lidar com o aumento da carga (escalabilidade).

➢ Entender mecanismos de recuperação de falhas (resiliência).

➢ Implementar como os componentes se comunicam (protocolos, formatos de mensagem, etc).

➢ Implementar autenticação, autorização e criptografia (segurança).

➢ Entender e implementar divisão do sistema em partes menores e gerenciáveis.



❖ Implementação:

➢ Garantir a aderência às boas práticas de desenvolvimento (Solid, Clean Code, etc).

➢ Escrever código legível, organizado e de fácil manutenção.

➢ Utilizar a linguagem C# de forma eficiente.

➢ Implementar testes com boa cobertura, qualidade e relevância.

➢ Cumprir os requisitos técnicos obrigatórios.

➢ Atender aos requisitos de negócio.



❖ Documentação e Apresentação:

➢ Documentar as aplicações de forma clara e concisa.

➢ Criar e entender diagramas que representam a arquitetura.

➢ Justificar as decisões tomadas.

➢ Escrever instruções claras e detalhadas de como a aplicação funciona e como rodar localmente

(Readme).

➢ Descrever possíveis melhorias ou expansões do sistema.

➢ Demonstrar capacidade de visão e planejamento a longo prazo.

➢ Reportar e discutir trade-offs e desafios enfrentados durante o desenvolvimento.



❖ Diferenciais e Boas Práticas:

➢ Garantir que o código seja executado de forma local e sem erros.

➢ Utilizar estratégias de Docker e Docker Compose.

➢ Implementar pipeline automatizada (CI/CD).

➢ Utilizar estratégias de IaC (Infraestrutura como Código).


Requisitos e qualificações

❖ Experiência:

➢ Experiência comprovada em sistemas com arquiteturas de software escaláveis, resilientes e seguras.

➢ Experiência prática em desenvolvimento de software utilizando a linguagem C#.

➢ Experiência com a aplicação de princípios de design de software (SOLID, Clean Code, etc.).

➢ Experiência com a implementação de testes automatizados (unitários, integração, etc.).

➢ Experiência com padrões de arquitetura (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).


❖ Conhecimentos Técnicos:

➢ Profundo conhecimento da linguagem C# e do ecossistema .NET.

➢ Sólido conhecimento de padrões de design de software (Design Patterns).

➢ Conhecimento de princípios de arquitetura de software (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).

➢ Conhecimento de práticas de desenvolvimento ágil (Scrum, Kanban).

➢ Conhecimento de segurança da informação (autenticação, autorização, criptografia).

➢ Conhecimento de ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git).

➢ Conhecimento de Docker e Docker Compose.

➢ Conhecimento de Kubernetes e orquestração de containers.

➢ Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais.

➢ Familiaridade com metodologias de testes (TDD, BDD).

➢ Familiaridade com CI/CD (Integração Contínua / Entrega Contínua).

➢ Familiaridade de IaC (Infraestrutura como Código).


❖ Habilidades:

➢ Excelente capacidade de comunicação e colaboração para trabalhar em equipe.

➢ Habilidade de análise crítica e resolução de problemas complexos.

➢ Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas claras e concisas.

➢ Habilidade de tomar decisões técnicas embasadas em dados.

➢ Habilidade de documentar soluções de forma clara e organizada.

➢ Capacidade de aprender e se adaptar a novas tecnologias e ferramentas.


❖ Diferenciais:

➢ Experiência em processos de Code Review, receber e fornecer feedbacks construtivos.

➢ Vivência prática com ambientes de cloud (GCP, AWS ou Azure).

➢ Conhecimento em estratégias e ferramentas de cache (ex: Redis, Memcached).

➢ Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade (monitoramento, logging, tracing) (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Jaeger).

Informações adicionais

Aqui nós somos humanos, somos digitais, somos Verity!


Tudo o que fazemos se baseia em nossos Valores Fascinantes :

  • Tecnologia:

Nossa Paixão por tecnologia nos impulsiona a modernizar e acelerar negócios;


  • Transparência e Comprometimento:

Somos guiados pela transparência e comprometimento com a entrega;


  • Conexão Humana:

Somos humanos que escutam com empatia e colaboram nas diferenças;


  • Experiência:

Construímos nossa reputação nos desafiando diariamente para entregar as melhores experiências para nossos clientes e colaboradores;



É assim que criamos experiências inovadoras para o mundo digital, inspirando protagonismo e gerando resultados incríveis aos nossos clientes, sempre focados em metodologia, tecnologia e pessoas.


Fomos certificados como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar pelo Great Place To Work, e a cada dia criamos ações que melhoram ainda mais o ambiente de trabalho, aqui na Verity você tem:

  • Vale refeição
  • Vale alimentação
  • Auxílio home office
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Seguro de vida
  • Parcerias de descontos
  • Convênios em estabelecimentos e instituições de ensino
  • Treinamentos de agilidade recorrentes
  • Intervalo Verity
  • #VerityComVocê
  • Viva Engage

Desenvolvemos e aceleramos produtos digitais, entregando resultados reais por meio da tecnologia. Combinamos Inteligência Artificial, Design e Engenharia de Software para oferecer modernização de aplicações, experiências digitais, outsourcing e consultoria.


Com o Verity Quantum, nosso framework de Inteligência Artificial com diversos agentes prontos, também ajudamos empresas a criar e orquestrar seus próprios agentes inteligentes.


Há 15 anos, trabalhamos com mais de 100 empresas líderes em seus setores, incluindo bancos, meios de pagamento, seguradoras, saúde, indústrias e serviços, para transformar negócios e acelerar resultados.

title: Solution Architect/ Technical Architect
description:
Position : Solution Architect/ Technical Architect

Location : Brazil - Remote

Duration: 12+ months

Rate : DOE


15+ years of IT experience and minimum of 10+ years using public cloud offerings such as Microsoft Azure, Azure Migrate, Azure SQL IaaS/PaaS, Azure Storage , Azure Key Vault, Azure IAM

Primary skills:

  • Demonstrates a high level of proficiency and hands-on expertise in delivering high quality designs using Architecture frameworks
  • Conducting AS-IS assessments of applications, designing target state architecture, and obtaining approvals from client architecture review board.
  • Expertise in On-prem/Public cloud Infra assessments using Azure Migrate
  • Driving the cloud Solutioning Azure activities for large complex migration
  • Ensure that the proposed solution covers Azure strategy, stakeholder management as well as the actual solution covering Business, Application and Infrastructure as well as commercial aspects (in terms of value for money and not commercial costing etc.)
  • Working experience with various industry domains like banking, healthcare, Insurance
  • Understanding customer Infra landscape. Design and build Azure Landing Zone activities
  • Provide the Azure target architecture and its BoM pricing and licensing related details
  • Azure Target Solutions architect Diagram (all Azure services) including HLD & LLD
  • Troubleshooting experience with Azure & Windows environments (Processor, networking, clusters, IO, memory etc. related issues)

Secondary Skills:

  • Design infrastructure/Data storage solutions
  • Design business continuity/DR solutions
  • Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
  • Work with Internal stakeholders, Customer stakeholders and Project Managers to understand the migration requirements and provide solutions accordingly

Certifications (Good to have)

  • AZ-305: Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions
  • AZ-104: Microsoft Azure Administrator

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Location: San Francisco, CA - Remote (LATAM preferred)

Work Type: Full-Time


We’re partnering with a confidential, high-growth technology company in Silicon Valley that’s building AI-powered platforms. This team moves fast, cares about craftsmanship, and empowers engineers to own meaningful work for the long term.


This is a full-time, remote opportunity to join a global-first product team tackling complex problems with modern tech and a culture that values quality and speed.


✅ What You’ll Do

- Design, build, and maintain features across the stack.

- Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering peers to ship high-quality work.

- Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code.

- Contribute to architecture decisions, technical planning, and code reviews.

- Help shape team workflows, best practices, and developer experience.


What You Bring

- 5+ years of professional experience in software development as a Full Stack Developer.

- 2+ years of professional experience as an AI/ML Engineer.

- Proficiency with Python, React, Express, MongoDB, Node or equivalent .

- Strong understanding of APIs, performance, scalability, etc..

- Clear, proactive communication and comfort working on distributed, async teams.

- A product mindset and strong sense of ownership.

- Startup or high-growth team background

- Proficiency in English

- Passion for building scalable systems and great user experiences.


What You’ll Get

title: .NET Developer
description:
Role: .NET Developer

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil (Onsite)

Mode: CLT (Full Time)


Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience in .NET and .NET Core development


Core Technologies:

ASP.NET, .NET, .NET Core, C#, SQL Server, Angular (mandatory), AngularJS (good to have), jQuery, Bootstrap

Tools: Bitbucket / GitHub / Jenkins etc.


Key responsibilities:

• Design, develop, and maintain full-stack web applications using .NET languages like C# and frameworks such as ASP.NET and .NET Core.

• Collaborate with UX/UI designers to build responsive and user-friendly interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including frameworks like Angular, React, or Vue.js.

• Develop and consume back-end services and APIs to facilitate communication between the front-end and server-side components.

• Implement and manage data storage solutions using databases like SQL Server and an ORM like Entity Framework.

• Ensure application performance, quality, and responsiveness through testing, debugging, and code reviews.

• Work with product managers and other stakeholders to gather and understand project requirements.

• Stay updated with the latest industry trends and best practices in .NET development.

• Participate in architectural and technical discussions, and provide mentorship to other team members.


Required skills and experience

• Proficiency in C# and the .NET Framework/.NET Core.

• Experience with front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and frameworks (Angular, React, Vue.js).

• Experience in designing and developing RESTful APIs.

• Experience with databases such as SQL Server and ORMs like Entity Framework.

• Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

• Knowledge of software development lifecycle, including requirement gathering, design, development, and testing.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
OSF Digital is a leading global digital transformation company, operating in over 30 countries worldwide. As a Salesforce Partner, we specialize in providing innovative solutions to help businesses achieve their digital goals. We are proud to be the only global Salesforce partner recognized in the top 5 categories, highlighting our commitment to excellence and customer success. With a strong focus on leveraging cutting‑edge technologies and industry best practices, our team of experts is dedicated to driving growth and efficiency for our clients across various industries. Embracing a 100% remote culture for over 20 years, we are committed to flexibility and work-life balance for our employees.

We are looking for a talented and motivated UX/UI Designer to join our UX team. If you are proactive, organized, and passionate about creating exceptional user experiences, we want to meet you!


Responsibilities

• UX Research: Conduct research using techniques such as desk research, user and stakeholder interviews, benchmarking, surveys, persona creation, user journeys, empathy maps, user flows, sitemaps, and more.

• Perform tests such as user testing, shadowing, field research, tree testing, and A/B testing to generate valuable insights during project discovery.

• UI Design: Develop low-, medium-, and high-fidelity prototypes, creating visually appealing and functional interfaces aligned with user and project needs.


Requirements

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience in UX and UI projects.

• Intermediate English for conversation is required.

• Spanish is considered a plus.


Skills

• Strong experience in UX Research and UI Design.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively, with excellent organizational and time-management skills.

• Excellent communication skills to present ideas and collaborate with different stakeholders.

• Proficiency with design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Miro, Maze, and others.

• Strategic thinking, context awareness, and ability to adapt solutions to project needs.


OSF Digital is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, where you can bring your whole self to work. Join an inclusive and passionate community of professionals who help bring about digital transformation for businesses around the world. At OSF Digital, we welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, or any other protected category in any of the jurisdictions in which we conduct business.

title: Product Owner
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Colaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.


Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively.
  • Excellent Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Software Development processes and tools to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is preferred.
  • Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required


Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

title: Financial Institutions Partnership Director
description:
Job Description

●Build up strategic partnership with major financial institutions in the respective regions/business line, nurturing business collaboration with global banks and other financial institutions to enhance the company services on providing payment, collection and other services that is related to B2B verticals and merchants growth.

●Develop and execute channel partnership strategy through identifying the potential partners, negotiating, closing partnership deals, implementing, and managing complex partnership engagements.

●Ensure project deliverable in terms of channel integration and optimisation are executed with quality and timely.

●Review process gaps, identify areas for improvement and drive the payment optimisation. ●Manage partnerships to review success factors and hold periodic meetings to discuss sales & marketing strategies, lead-gen, and new products/features.

●Research on the business model and compliance policy of oversea funds management practice in local market.



The Successful Applicant:

●Min 5 years of working experience in collaboration with local financial institution or payment channel industry.

●In-depth understanding on local regulation and compliance regarding payment business and cross border fund movement.

●Experience in negotiation and partnership proposal development

●Ability to maintain high efficiency across different countries

●Solid interpersonal skills, logical thinking and analytical skills

●Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities, enjoys working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

title: Consultor Óptico
description:
Nós somos a EssilorLuxottica, líder global no design, fabricação e distribuição de lentes oftálmicas, armações e óculos de sol. A empresa reúne a expertise complementar de dois pioneiros da indústria, um em tecnologias avançadas de lentes e outro na arte da fabricação de óculos icônicos, criando um negócio verticalmente integrado, única e exclusivamente posicionado para atender às necessidades de visão em constante evolução do mundo e à demanda global de uma indústria de óculos em crescimento. Com mais de 180.000 colaboradores em 150 países impulsionando nossas marcas icônicas, nossas pessoas são criativas, empreendedoras e reconhecidas por suas perspectivas e individualidades únicas. Comprometidos com a visão, nós capacitamos as pessoas a \"verem mais e serem mais\" graças aos nossos designs inovadores e tecnologias de lentes, qualidade excepcional e métodos de processamento de ponta. Todos os dias impactamos a vida de milhões de pessoas ao mudar a maneira como elas veem o mundo.


Responsabilidades da posição:

  • Contatar, prospectar e visitar clientes;
  • Divulgar e gerar demanda de vendas de produtos e serviços para a empresa;
  • Elaborar junto com o gestor um planejamento de visitas mensal;
  • Ministrar treinamentos com clientes;
  • Realizar manutenção de carteira de clientes, atualizando-as sempre que necessário;
  • Promover o aumento de vendas dentro da sua carteira de clientes;
  • Buscar informações de mercado a fim de identificar clientes com potencial, e possíveis ameaças da concorrência;
  • Elaborar relatório diário de visitas no sistema;
  • Alcançar as metas propostas;
  • Acompanhar a performance dos clientes para construir planos de ação com base nesses resultados;
  • Reforçar campanhas e capacitar as lojas para que vendam mais e melhor os nossos produtos.


Requisitos da posição:

  • Graduação completa ou cursando;
  • Interesse no segmento óptico;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Carteira de habilitação (B) definitiva;
  • Conhecimentos do Pacote Office;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Boa capacidade analítica.


*A Essilorluxottica valoriza e apoia a diversidade, por esse motivo, todas as nossas vagas são abertas para candidaturas de profissionais PCDs.

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
Location: San Francisco, CA - Remote (LATAM preferred)

Work Type: Full-Time


We’re partnering with a confidential, high-growth technology company in Silicon Valley that’s building AI-powered platforms. This team moves fast, cares about craftsmanship, and empowers engineers to own meaningful work for the long term.


This is a full-time, remote opportunity to join a global-first product team tackling complex problems with modern tech and a culture that values quality and speed.


✅ What You’ll Do

- Design, build, and maintain features across the stack.

- Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering peers to ship high-quality work.

- Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code.

- Contribute to architecture decisions, technical planning, and code reviews.

- Help shape team workflows, best practices, and developer experience.


What You Bring

- 5+ years of professional experience in software development as a Full Stack Developer.

- 2+ years of professional experience as an AI/ML Engineer.

- Proficiency with Python, React, Express, MongoDB, Node or equivalent .

- Strong understanding of APIs, performance, scalability, etc..

- Clear, proactive communication and comfort working on distributed, async teams.

- A product mindset and strong sense of ownership.

- Startup or high-growth team background

- Proficiency in English

- Passion for building scalable systems and great user experiences.


What You’ll Get

- Competitive compensation in USD.

- 100% remote with flexible hours.

- Long-term, product-focused work with clear ownership.

- A smart, collaborative, globally distributed team.


If you’re excited to work with a fast-moving team building the future of AI at scale — let’s connect.

title: Especialista em sistemas de granadas
description:
US$ 1100 – 2800 por mês

Serviço oficial nas unidades militares das Forças Armadas da Ucrânia

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar tarefas de guarda e patrulha
  • Deslocamentos à linha de frente
  • Proteger objetos estratégicos e infraestrutura crítica
  • Realizar tarefas de preparo de posições para defesa

Requisitos

  • Idioma de comunicação - Espanhol ou Inglês
  • Treinamento militar ou experiência relevante será um diferencial
  • Disponibilidade para atuar por longos períodos no campo
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em zona de guerra
  • Sem vícios em álcool ou drogas
  • Sem distinção de nacionalidade

Condições

  • US$ 500 durante o treinamento, US$ 1100–2800 durante as tarefas (dependendo do local), + US$ 1670 por cada 30 dias na linha de frente
  • Assinatura de contrato de 3 anos (rescisão possível após 6 meses), período de experiência de 2 meses
  • Um mês de treinamento especializado e exercícios com instrutores profissionais
  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares

  • Executar tarefas de atirador em diversos tipos de armamentos
  • Trabalhar com diferentes tipos de armas
  • Ajuste de tiro e operação de dispositivos de mira
  • Realizar a manutenção e preparo técnico das armas
  • Participar de operações de combate
  • Manter comunicação com o comando e outras unidades para coordenar ações

Requisitos

  • Idioma de comunicação - Espanhol ou Inglês
  • Treinamento militar ou experiência relevante será um diferencial
  • Experiência com armamento de Veículo Blindado de Combate à Infantaria (BMP) ou Veículo Blindado de Transporte de Tropas (BTR) será um diferencial
  • Capacidade de avaliar rapidamente o cenário de combate e ajustar a resposta de fogo
  • Boa resistência física e capacidade de trabalhar sob condições extremas
  • Capacidade de avaliar rapidamente o cenário de combate e ajustar a resposta de fogo
  • Sem vícios em álcool ou drogas
  • Sem distinção de nacionalidade

Condições

  • US$ 500 durante o treinamento, US$ 1100–2800 durante as tarefas (dependendo do local), + US$ 1670 por cada 30 dias na linha de frente
  • Assinatura de contrato de 3 anos (rescisão possível após 6 meses), período de experiência de 2 meses
  • Um mês de treinamento especializado e exercícios com instrutores profissionais
  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Corretor imobiliário
description:
Descrição da Empresa De Sá Imob.

Descrição do Cargo Estamos à procura de um Corretor Imobiliário para se juntar à DE SÁ IMOB em Londrina, PR. O profissional será responsável por intermediar a compra, venda e locação de imóveis, atendendo clientes e oferecendo suporte especializado em todas as etapas das transações imobiliárias. As tarefas diárias incluem visitar e avaliar propriedades, realizar apresentações e mostrar imóveis a potenciais clientes, negociar contratos e acompanhar processos burocráticos. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer presença no local.

Qualificações

  • Corretagem e Imóveis: Necessário conhecimento em corretagem e no mercado imobiliário, além de ser capaz de identificar oportunidades de negócios.
  • Serviço ao Cliente: Habilidade em atendimento ao cliente, com foco em fornecer um serviço de alta qualidade e atender às necessidades dos clientes.
  • Vendas: Experiência em vendas é essencial, incluindo a capacidade de negociar e fechar contratos de maneira eficaz.
  • Além dessas habilidades, serão considerados diferenciais o conhecimento em legislação imobiliária e a capacidade de utilizar ferramentas tecnológicas de gestão imobiliária.

title: Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Basis Consultant who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Technical

Strong knowledge of IT Service Management, SAP Basis and SAP Applications

Hands-on experience with SAP Basis activities, SAP release version upgrades and infrastructure updates for cloud customers

Working experience with SAP HEC, SAP S/4HANA or any other cloud solution.

Hands-on experience with infrastructure operations, network, interfaces and Load Balancer topics related to SAP landscape management (TLO)

Strong technical troubleshooting skills with the ability to form the solution/designing the mechanism for end to end solutioning

Hands on experience in Migration (onpremise to Cloud/Cross cloud/Cross DC's)


Soft Skills

Excellent customer focus / Networking / Relationship Building /Results-driven / Self-organized / Decision making

Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)

Understanding of escalation handling and procedures with customers while proactively working with internal teams towards arriving at a resolution

Experience in working with cross-cultural and cross-functional teams or individuals

Proficiency in English (Written and verbal)


Good to have

Cloud architecture and IT technical infrastructure know-how

Knowledge of/certification in one of Azure, AWS or GCP fundamentals

Experience with Migration, Upgrade projects esp. on S/4H Cloud

Knowledge of Project Management Fundamentals, ITIL, Lean Fundamentals is a plus



What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Basis Consultant who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Technical

Strong knowledge of IT Service Management, SAP Basis and SAP Applications

Hands-on experience with SAP Basis activities, SAP release version upgrades and infrastructure updates for cloud customers

Working experience with SAP HEC, SAP S/4HANA or any other cloud solution.

Hands-on experience with infrastructure operations, network, interfaces and Load Balancer topics related to SAP landscape management (TLO)

Strong technical troubleshooting skills with the ability to form the solution/designing the mechanism for end to end solutioning

Hands on experience in Migration (onpremise to Cloud/Cross cloud/Cross DC's)


Soft Skills

Excellent customer focus / Networking / Relationship Building /Results-driven / Self-organized / Decision making

Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)

Understanding of escalation handling and procedures with customers while proactively working with internal teams towards arriving at a resolution

Experience in working with cross-cultural and cross-functional teams or individuals

Proficiency in English (Written and verbal)


Good to have

Cloud architecture and IT technical infrastructure know-how

Knowledge of/certification in one of Azure, AWS or GCP fundamentals

Experience with Migration, Upgrade projects esp. on S/4H Cloud

Knowledge of Project Management Fundamentals, ITIL, Lean Fundamentals is a plus



What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: Sales Manager -  Nutraceutical Ingredients ( LATAM)
description:
Sales Manager - Nutraceutical Ingredients ( LATAM)


Location: Brazil (Remote)


Territory: Latin America


About the Role


We’re seeking a Sales Manager to drive growth across LATAM. You will sell nutraceutical ingredients to the dietary supplement and functional food & beverage industries, building a high-quality pipeline and long-term customer relationships.


Responsibilities

• Manage and grow key accounts across LATAM, fostering senior-level relationships with brand owners, CDMOs/contract manufacturers, and distributors.

• Develop and execute country- and segment-level territory plans to capture new business.

• Present nutraceutical ingredients to customers, clearly articulating benefits, applications, and go-to-market plans.

• Collaborate with technical, regulatory, and marketing teams to deliver tailored solutions and product launches.

• Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify white space and protect share.

• Meet and exceed quarterly/annual sales targets with accurate forecasting and disciplined CRM hygiene.

• Represent the company at regional trade shows, conferences, and industry events.

• Provide technical/product support to customers in coordination with internal teams.

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of regional regulations and standards (e.g., ANVISA, COFEPRIS, INVIMA).


Requirements

• 5+ years of B2B sales experience in nutraceutical ingredients within LATAM.

• Strong understanding of nutraceutical ingredients and their applications in dietary supplements and functional F&B.

• Proven ability to prospect, build pipelines, negotiate, and close across multiple countries.

• Language: Fluent Portuguese and strong Spanish; English is a plus.

• Self-starter comfortable working remotely; excellent territory/time management.

• Based in Brazil with willingness to travel across LATAM as required.

• Proficiency with MS Office and CRM (ZOHO preferred).

title: Data Engineer - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.

  • Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.

What we are looking for:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.

  • Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.

What we are looking for:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Analista de suporte e implantação de software
description:
Estamos contratando: Suporte / Implantador de Sistema Hablla


Você é apaixonado(a) por automação, integrações e criação de fluxos inteligentes? Já trabalhou com n8n, Make ou Zapier e adora transformar complexidade em simplicidade?


Então essa vaga é para você


Na Hablla, somos pioneiros em Marketing Conversacional Integrado (MCI), metodologia que conecta Marketing, Vendas, Atendimento, Customer Success e Performance em uma única plataforma conversacional. Nossa missão é ajudar empresas B2B a crescerem de forma integrada, inteligente e escalável.


O que você vai fazer no dia a dia


Implantar e configurar fluxos diretamente na plataforma Hablla, utilizando toda sua experiência prévia em automações.

Criar integrações via APIs REST e requisições HTTP, garantindo que os dados fluam com segurança e performance.

Manipular e transformar JSON em diferentes cenários de integração.

Diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos, garantindo a melhor experiência para nossos clientes.

Customizar cadências e jornadas de atendimento alinhadas à nossa metodologia MCI.

Colaborar com os times de Customer Success e Produto, trazendo insights para evolução contínua da plataforma.


O que esperamos de você


Experiência prática com plataformas de automação (n8n, Make, Zapier ou similares).

Conhecimento sólido em requisições HTTP e consumo de APIs REST.

Domínio em JSON para manipulação de dados.

Capacidade de diagnóstico e solução de problemas em integrações.

Boa comunicação, clareza e organização no dia a dia.


Vai ser um diferencial se você tiver:


Noções de Node.js ou javascript.

Conhecimento de Webhooks e mensageria em tempo real.

Vivência em implantação de SaaS B2B, CRM ou soluções Omnichannel.


O que oferecemos


Contrato PJ

R$ 4.500,00 nos 3 primeiros meses (período de experiência)

Após experiência: R$ 6.000,00 mensais

Oportunidade de crescer em uma startup inovadora, referência em tecnologia e Marketing Conversacional.


Se você se identificou, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de uma empresa que está transformando a forma como negócios se comunicam, envie seu perfil e venha construir o futuro da comunicação com a gente!

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, \"mostly right\" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a \"big picture\" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!
